project_summary: Patient portal with appointment scheduling, HL7 FHIR integration, and GDPR-compliant health records

components.name: FHIR R4 resource gateway
components.description: Patient, Observation, and Appointment resources exposed via FHIR API with SMART on FHIR authorization.

components.name: Appointment scheduling module
components.description: Provider calendars, waitlist, SMS reminders, and integration with clinic management system.

components.name: Electronic health record viewer
components.description: Read-only timeline of lab results, prescriptions, and visit notes with field-level encryption at rest.

components.name: Consent and data subject rights
components.description: Consent capture UI, export/portability requests, and right-to-erasure workflow with audit logs.

components.name: Healthcare identity provider
components.description: Integration with national health ID (SNS) and MFA for clinician vs patient roles.
